qualification: PROVISIONAL N08 depth-return calibration scene only; the physical ceiling is mapped as occupied and does not authorize flight.
description: A finite overhead boundary around the N08 support-scan and low-speed calibration volume. The depth mapper must observe the surface and establish free rays; no occupancy is injected into the map.

geometry.frame: spawn-relative N05 layout; runtime layout offset is spawn position plus 1.5 m along spawn yaw

rationale: The source world has no overhead depth-return surface. A real collision/visual ceiling inside sensor range can make rays through the intended low-speed volume observable while remaining above the EGO body plus terminal-hold query. Raw unknown remains blocked; the ceiling must appear as raw occupied in the map.
